name: What is the typical timeframe for a cabinet installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a cabinet installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for cabinet installation can vary significantly based on the project's scope, cabinet type (e.g., custom vs. stock), and site readiness. A standard kitchen cabinet installation might take 3-5 days once the cabinets are delivered and the space is prepared. More complex projects involving custom designs, multiple rooms, or extensive demolition and structural modifications will naturally require more time. It's crucial to have the space clear and all plumbing and electrical rough-ins complete before installation begins to avoid delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet installation typically takes 3-5 days for a standard kitchen, but can vary based on project scope and cabinet type.
